title: Joining a Circle is free for any signed-in member: the Join button no longer opens the Crew upgrade, and Crew stays the tier for hosting

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14 (decision 1A, confirmed: "1 join free"): Circle Join is free to join; Crew stays for hosting.

detail: Both Join buttons on a Circle (the Frequency cover's and DAWN's) were wrapped in CrewGateButton, so a member who was not on Crew got the upgrade lightbox instead of joining, though the join itself (lib/circles/join.ts, admin client) already admits a free member. The wrapper is gone, so Join joins. The layout no longer reads isPaidViewer for it. Hosting and the other Crew gates are unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/(main)/circles/[slug]/(circle)/layout.tsx','utf8');if(/<CrewGateButton[^>]*label=.Join/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-875: the Circle Join button still opens the Crew upgrade');process.exit(1)}"
